2608.13226.title: CoverPrune: Coverage-Driven Token Pruning for 3D VLMs via Optimal Transport
2608.13226.paper_summary: While 3D Vision-Language Models (3D VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable spatial reasoning capabilities, they suffer from massive visual token counts that create severe computational bottlenecks during inference. Existing token pruning methods primarily rely on diversity-based selection, discarding similar tokens to maximize dispersion. However, in 3D environments, this approach frequently drops representative prototype tokens in favor of outliers, breaking the multi-view consistencies and geometric structures essential for spatial reasoning. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift for 3D VLM token pruning: from maximizing diversity to preserving visual evidence coverage. We introduce CoverPrune, a training-free framework that formulates inference-time token pruning as an Optimal Transport (OT) problem. To overcome the intractable combinatorial subset selection inherent in this formulation, we design the Feature-Spatial-Temporal (FST) transport cost and target capacity, along with an efficient Spatial-Guided Greedy Selection (SGS) algorithm to approximate the OT objective. Furthermore, we propose CoverPrune-Lite, an accelerated variant utilizing spatially structured local matching for minimal overhead. Extensive experiments across multiple 3D visual-spatial reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our methods achieve state-of-the-art token efficiency, maintaining robust reasoning performance even under highly aggressive pruning budgets. Visit our project website at https://github.com/Brucess/CoverPrune.
2608.13226.paper_summary_zh: 雖然3D視覺-語言模型（3D VLMs）展現了卓越的空間推理能力，但它們在推理過程中面臨大量視覺標記數量，造成嚴重的計算瓶頸。現有的標記修剪方法主要依賴基於多樣性的選擇，丟棄相似的標記以最大化分散性。然而，在3D環境中，這種方法經常會放棄代表性的原型標記，偏向於異常值，破壞了對於空間推理至關重要的多視角一致性和幾何結構。在本文中，我們提出了3D VLM標記修剪的範式轉變：從最大化多樣性轉向保留視覺證據覆蓋。我們引入了CoverPrune，一個無需訓練的框架，將推理時的標記修剪公式化為最優運輸（OT）問題。為了克服這一公式中固有的難以處理的組合子集選擇，我們設計了特徵-空間-時間（FST）運輸成本和目標容量，並結合一個高效的空間引導貪婪選擇（SGS）算法來近似OT目標。此外，我們提出了CoverPrune-Lite，一個加速變體，利用空間結構的局部匹配以減少開銷。針對多個3D視覺-空間推理基準的廣泛實驗表明，我們的方法實現了最先進的標記效率，即使在高度激進的修剪預算下也能保持穩健的推理性能。請訪問我們的項目網站 https://github.com/Brucess/CoverPrune。
